name: Mission Craft Furniture
old_description: Handcrafted solid wood furniture built in Portland — designed to last generations
about:
Mission Craft Furniture operates from Portland, Oregon, where it has been making furniture in the Pacific Northwest for over 25 years. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The shop produces handcrafted solid-wood furniture — beds, chairs, nightstands, and chests — using premium hardwoods such as cherry and walnut with non-toxic finishes. All pieces are built without veneers or particle board. The company describes its team as skilled woodworkers but does not publish facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The company sells directly to residential customers, offering nationwide delivery and in-home setup, as noted in customer reviews. No specific industry verticals or commercial clients are identified in the available information.

The company emphasizes a lifetime warranty, solid-hardwood construction without veneers, non-toxic finishes, and local Portland craftsmanship as its distinguishing factors.
